sections.h2: Everything on a Hawthorne property, from the slab to the ceiling
body: Property owners in Hawthorne rarely need just one thing. A lake house might need the siding washed, a few fascia boards replaced, the exterior repainted, and the deck stained, while the kitchen inside is waiting on new cabinet color. Our painting services in Hawthorne, FL are built so all of that can live on one itemized estimate instead of three separate contractors with three schedules.
Below is the full menu, grouped the way we usually sequence it on site.

bullets: Pressure washing and soft washing for siding, drives, and decks
Drywall repair and patching, including nail pops
Stucco repair ahead of elastomeric coatings
Wallpaper removal and popcorn ceiling removal, with a dustless option
Rot and fascia replacement on wood trim

body: Once surfaces are sound, the coating work begins. Inside, that means walls, ceilings, trim, doors, and room-by-room interior repaints. Outside, it covers siding, soffits, fascia, shutters, and masonry. Wood gets penetrating stains rather than paint wherever the grain should show, which is why deck staining for Hawthorne yards is quoted with its own prep steps.
bullets: Commercial painting for offices, shops, churches, and schools
Deck and fence staining, door and shutter painting
Concrete and masonry painting, garage floor epoxy and polyaspartic coatings
Decorative finishes such as limewash, venetian plaster, and metallics

sections.h2: Why the order of work matters
body: Washing always comes first, because mildew and pollen left on a wall will lift the new film. Carpentry repairs follow, then caulk and primer, then topcoats. Decks and fences are stained after the body of the house so drips and overspray land on unfinished wood, not on a fresh stain. Bundling the work lets us plan that sequence in a single mobilization, and our complete service list explains each item in more depth.

The estimate names the Sherwin-Williams or Benjamin Moore line used on each surface. Two full coats are the baseline, and a third goes on porous substrates or big color changes. If you want to phase the work, the line items make it easy to do the exterior this season and the fence next spring.

If you are not sure what your property needs, ask for a walkthrough. A crew lead will flag what is urgent and what can wait. For the bigger picture of who we are in town, see our Hawthorne painting contractor page.

faqs.q: Can you handle washing, repairs, and painting on the same Hawthorne job?
faqs.a: Yes. Washing, rot replacement, caulking, priming, and painting are all done by our own crews, and each step is listed on one estimate.

faqs.q: Do you offer specialty work like popcorn ceiling removal or epoxy floors?
faqs.a: We do. Popcorn removal (including dustless removal), garage floor epoxy and polyaspartic coatings, and decorative finishes are all part of our service list.

faqs.q: Can I split a large project into phases?
faqs.a: Yes. Because the quote is itemized, you can approve some line items now and schedule the rest later without re-pricing the whole job.
